description: The bar chart illustrates the model evaluation on academic and practical benchmarks, comparing the performance of two models, LLaMA-3-8B-it and Ours (Iterative RLHF), across nine different datasets and metrics. The horizontal axis represents the dataset and metrics, listed in the order: GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (x5), and Chat-Arena-Hard. The vertical axis is labeled "Score (%)", with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, marked at intervals of 10. Each dataset and metric is associated with a pair of bars, with LLaMA-3-8B-it represented in blue and Ours (Iterative RLHF) in orange. The scores for LLaMA-3-8B-it range from approximately 18% for Chat-Arena-Hard to 79% for GSM-8K, while Ours (Iterative RLHF) scores range from around 27% for Chat-Arena-Hard to 80% for GSM-8K. The bars are grouped by dataset and metric, with the two models' scores presented side by side for each category. The chart does not display any specific sorting order for the bars beyond their listed order on the horizontal axis, and no bars are visually emphasized.
